summary: Donut chart that sweeps in clockwise; hovering or arrowing to a segment pops it outward and rolls its share into the centre.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Comma-separated `Label:value` pairs, split at the last colon. Values are relative and shown as rounded percentages of their sum; a missing or negative value counts as 0. Observed: a change rebuilds the chart and it sweeps in again.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text in the centre and the start of the `aria-label`. Observed.

attributes.name: total
attributes.description: Text in the centre when no segment is focused. Defaults to the sum of the values. Observed.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"`, `tabindex="0"` and an `aria-label` listing each segment percentage.
The centre text is not a live region.
Legend rows react to pointer hover only. Moving focus away from the canvas clears the highlight.
motion: With reduced motion the donut appears without the sweep and the centre text swaps without rolling; the segment pop still eases.
notes: Colours cycle through accent, ok, warn, danger and muted; a sixth segment reuses the accent colour.
The chart is fixed at 176 × 176 px.

data.note: Pass your `Label:value` segments as `data` (and `total` for the centre). Without it the chart shows invented usage shares.
